reviewScope.summary: Self-review of owner decision D5 on master 14f38fb (PR #103 merged): the Guild card's competitive 'Ukas rangering' becomes 'Medlemmer', listed in the server's stable join order without rank numbers. Each member's deliberately shared day count and the shared weekly goal stay; no new data is uploaded and nothing infers inactivity.
evidence: summarizeGroup no longer sorts or ranks; it returns the server's members array (social_week orders by member_order) with the unchanged total and 2 x members target.
Unit test asserts the members come back in join order with a non-sorted fixture (0, 3, 2 days).
e2e/learning-group.spec.ts now expects 'Ada (deg) 0 dager' before 'Bo 1 dag', the fixture's join order, which the old sort would have reversed.
Sister search: no remaining 'rangering', 'ranking' or learning-group__ranking references in src, e2e or tests.

Local Playwright, --max-failures=0, the six specs that touch the Guild (learning-group, learning-week.offline, hero-recent-badges, rpg-app-theme, rpg-mobile-overflow, rpg-primary-nav-layout): 61 of 61 passed, including the existing 320 px overflow check and the axe scan of the Guild panel.
Vitest tests/features/social and tests/architecture: 164 of 164 after merging master 14f38fb. Prettier on changed files, eslint --max-warnings 0 on changed TypeScript, npm run typecheck pass.
The master merge conflicted only in docs/CURRENT_STATE.md; both top entries are kept and the S1 entry now records its merge.

adversarialFindings.description: Per-member shared day counts remain visible, so members can still compare themselves.
adversarialFindings.resolution: D5 keeps intentionally shared information where useful; the counts are what each member chose to share, and without ordering or rank numbers the list is no longer a leaderboard.

adversarialFindings.description: Join order puts the administrator first, which the list does not label.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Unchanged behaviour of the stable order; labelling the administrator would be new UI outside D5.
